text:
incident-bot: Pager: continuous-batch perf cliff detected in us-west-2 - inferencesvc-prod. Sudden jump in queueing and tail latency at 2024-11-03T18:14:59Z. Auto-paging eng-oncall.
ashwin: seeing massive kv cache churn + microbatch collapse. p95->2.1s p999->14s. lots of dropped coalesces.
maria: graphs confirm a sharp rise in queue_length and jitter across batching timers (~150-220ms). customer 5xx rate rising.
elaine: any deploys in the last 20m? deploy-bot shows none.
sre-jordan: preliminary: prefetch + adaptive batching interaction under very high concurrency causing kvcache churn -> continuous batching can't form stable microbatches.
ops-robert: logs: ```worker: continuous_batch overflow seq=9112
kvcache: aggressive_eviction triggered keys=chat-completion:routeX:* freq=very_high
router: pool=us-west-2-prod queue=1024 inflight=140 batch_policy=adaptive```
ashwin: quick mitigation plan: reduce router max_inflight for pool to 50%, cap microbatch token size to 48, and temporarily disable aggressive_prefetch. will push config shim.
maria: do it. notify support about possible customer-visible latency.
elaine: executing emergency change. posting config: ```POST /orchestrator/v1/config {"pool":"us-west-2-prod","max_inflight_pct":50,"microbatch_max_tokens":48,"aggressive_prefetch":false}```
incident-bot: emergency config applied by elaine @ 1766778953
ops-robert: turning off prefetch heuristic now, reverting prefetch window extension from earlier experiment.
ashwin: adding tenant-level soft rate limits for noisy tenants (id-prefixes: noisy-*, batch-test-*). set to 20qps per tenant.
maria: support: flagged three paying customers that saw latency >= 5s between 18:14-18:22 UTC. creating advisory draft.
sre-jordan: monitoring: after config changes p95 fell to ~700ms in 45s, p999 still elevated but falling. queue length halved.
ops-robert: eviction rate dropped ~70% per telemetry. continuous_batch_coalesce metric improving.
ashwin: opening hotpatch PR for runtime changes to kv_eviction_window and batch aggregation timeout. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4302 (hotpatch candidate).
elaine: canary plan: deploy hotpatch to 2 hosts in pool, observe 5m, then expand.
incident-bot: canary rollout started by ashwin @ 1766779020
ops-robert: during canary, one model route still spikes p999 - considering temporary route pinning to lower-memory variant while hotpatch rolls out.
maria: support update sent to impacted customers with ETA and mitigation summary.
sre-jordan: suggest keeping router concurrency cap + prefetch off for 30m, then slowly raise while watching evictions.
ashwin: canary metrics look stable after 6m. reduced evictions and microbatch sizes normalized. proceeding to staged rollout.
incident-bot: staged rollout completed by ashwin @ 1766779090
ops-robert: post-rollout metrics: p95=130ms, p999=920ms, queue normalized. recording mitigation timeline.
elaine: marking incident as mitigated in pager. will keep monitoring for 1h.
incident-bot: mitigation recorded, alert silenced @ 1766779150
maria: post-incident steps: 1) draft postmortem 2) customer advisory + timeline 3) follow-up on smart-eviction and prefetch backpressure.
sre-jordan: oncall handoff -> ashwin owns postmortem. target draft by 2024-11-04 20:00 UTC. include root cause, telemetry, and customer impact.
ashwin: filing follow-ups: implement backpressure-aware prefetch, increase kv cache grace window, add continuous-batch jitter SLOs and better per-route memory telemetry.
ops-robert: note in tracker: disabled aggressive_prefetch on pool us-west-2-prod; remember controlled re-enable after fixes.
maria: support to confirm final advisory and any credits.
incident-bot: thread closed (mitigated) @ 1766779205
